headline: Charter review of City Council rules in Article III, plus more information on Article II, Office of the Mayor, and Article IV, City Manager.
summary: Public comment is set for the start and end of the meeting. The agenda also lists minutes from October 29 and an amendment to the October 19 minutes, plus discussion topics for the November 16 meeting.

Next meeting on November 16 and discussion topics
